references.text: God gave Moses the two stone tablets with the testimony, written by God's finger.
Description of the first tablets that Moses received, written by God on both sides.
The Lord commanded Moses to carve out two new stone tablets like the first ones.
Moses wrote the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments, on the tablets.
The Ten Commandments that God spoke to Israel at Mount Sinai.
The Lord proclaimed His covenant, the Ten Commandments, and wrote them on two stone tablets.
The Lord spoke these words with a loud voice from the fire and wrote them on two stone tablets.
God gave Moses the tablets written by God's finger, containing all the words the Lord spoke from the fire on the day of assembly.
Paul refers to the stone tablets when he speaks about the ministry of the new covenant.
The ark of the covenant contained the stone tablets with the Ten Commandments.
